rows.title: Bacopa monnieri and Alzheimer's disease: mechanistic convergence, cognitive outcomes and translational perspectives.
rows.evidence_boundary: The Bacopa evidence base spans mechanistic and preclinical work with limited clinical translation; Alzheimer disease efficacy and disease modification are not established.

rows.title: AMPK-Directed Therapeutics for MASLD: Mechanistic Rationale, Activator Classes, and Clinical Translation.
rows.evidence_boundary: This review covers multiple AMPK-directed therapeutic classes and mechanisms; pathway plausibility does not establish efficacy for any particular supplement or natural compound in MASLD.

rows.title: Berberine as a multitarget modulator of metabolic inflammation: molecular mechanisms, circadian regulation, and translational perspectives.
rows.evidence_boundary: The review synthesizes broad mechanistic and translational evidence; berberine's low bioavailability, formulation differences, and heterogeneous clinical contexts limit direct efficacy generalization.

rows.title: Molecular Mechanisms of Obesity-Associated Oxidative Stress and Therapeutic Strategies.
rows.evidence_boundary: This is a mechanism-focused obesity review spanning many therapeutic strategies; redox-pathway plausibility should not be treated as proof that any specific antioxidant supplement improves clinical outcomes.

rows.title: Oxidative Stability and Nanoencapsulation of Marine Omega-3 LC-PUFAs for Sustainable Aquaculture and Human Health.
rows.evidence_boundary: The paper focuses on oxidation, feed and food-chain stability, and encapsulation of EPA/DHA rather than direct human clinical outcomes; formulation stability is not equivalent to efficacy.
